conversations.description: The king of Restoria, preparing a feast.

greeting.line: My cooks have fled before the grand feast. If you know your way around a hearth, perhaps you can help.

conversations.name: King

quests.completedNote: The feast is days away and my kitchens are in shambles. Ten baked potatoes, golden and crisp — and ten cooked crawfish beside them. Bring those to me and I shall not forget it.
quests.name: The Grand Feast

quests.summary: The king needs a new cook for the feast.
quests.talkLine: The feast is days away and my kitchens are in shambles. Ten baked potatoes, golden and crisp — and ten cooked crawfish beside them. Bring those to me and I shall not forget it.

mentor.knownNote: You know how to make bows and quivers.
mentor.line: A bow's only half the work — you'll want a quiver too. I can show you how to make both. Hunt with a bow and you pick up combat experience as well. The animals fight back; might as well learn from it.

conversations.description: Master of the forge. Speaks with you to unlock Smithing projects.

conversations.description: Master of Arcana at the Wizard's Tower.
conversations.name: Archmage

greeting.acceptLabel: Start quest: Help the aspiring apothecary
greeting.line: I'm tired of working in the kitchen. There's a lot for sale down the street — I keep thinking about the alchemy shop I've always wanted.

quests.acceptLabel: Start quest: Help the aspiring apothecary
quests.completedNote: If I'm going to open that shop I need a few things first. Rabbit's feet, fernleaf, wild berries, butterfly wings — five of each — and a thousand gold for the lease. Help me gather those and I can finally leave this kitchen.
